image_description: Two small Blenheim spaniel puppies sitting on a ground covered in dry brown leaves. The puppy on the left is facing forward with its head turned slightly to the right, showing a white face with brown patches over the ears and eyes. The puppy on the right is curled up, facing away from the camera, displaying a white body with large brown patches. Both have long, floppy, feathered ears and soft, fluffy coats.

The right puppy's head is tucked down, but the transition from neck to body lacks clear anatomical definition. The ear seems to merge directly into the shoulder/back fur without a distinct neck structure, suggesting slight structural ambiguity.

Standard depth-of-field blur, but some leaves near the contact points of the dogs show inconsistent sharpness, potentially indicating minor generation artifacts in the foreground-background interaction.
